name: No More Time [ALPHA]
desc:
WARNING: CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS

No More Time is a fast-paced, round-based, procedurally-generated parkour game with a focus on abilities and cooperation. This is not a competition, it's survival. Save the weak and carry them to safety.

You have 120 seconds. Keep moving or get caught by the corruption.

Early alpha, expect bugs and lack of polish.
